description: Parameter search space for VBx + erosion/dilation + AHC threshold (and clustering_backend)

embedding_dilation_size.description: Dilation kernel size for embedding extraction (0 = off)

embedding_erosion_size.description: Erosion kernel size after dilation for embedding extraction (0 = off)

post_oa_dilation_size.description: Dilation kernel size after overlap-add (0 = off)

post_oa_erosion_size.description: Erosion kernel size after post-OA dilation (0 = off)

fb.description: Scaling factor for cosine similarity (higher = more confident)

loopP.description: Self-loop probability in HMM (higher = fewer speaker changes)
